subject: phase 2 progress: validators, sources, coverage, official page, cards landed; forms next
body: On claude/naadi-shared: - 1047359: validators in CI and sources.yaml from the research. The originality check runs in fallback mode (documented in CONTENT_AUTHORING §9). - 13bbda2: tools/coverage.py, plus /admin/blueprint and /practice/official. The coverage gate only reports until config/content_coverage.yaml s23_complete is true. - f2f8bcb: tools/generate_cards.py builds cloze cards from key facts and objective cards from items. Its output, cards.generated.json, is CI drift-checked. Authors, please: - run python3 tools/generate_cards.py after editing a section or item; - mark key facts with ; - end explanations with a Takeaway: line. Next: the practice-form assembler and exam mode with sequential and abstract sets (needs migration 0040, claiming now).
